summary: Iteration 9 — PRESSAO command + fancoil detail redesign. 12/12 backend tests PASS; frontend validation of indicators/buttons/SVG/pressure flow all PASS.

backend.pressao_success: PASS — POST kind=PRESSAO value=50 → 200; topic ends with /9FE4/PRESSAO/SET; value='50.0'. Boundaries 0 and 100 accepted.
backend.pressao_validation: PASS — value=120 → 400 ('Pressão deve estar entre 0 e 100 %'); value=-5 → 400; value='abc' → 400 ('Pressão inválida').
backend.pressao_permissions: PASS — viewer → 403; operator with empty fancoil_ids → 403.
backend.pressao_no_estado_check: PASS — PRESSAO accepted in NORMAL mode (estado=true) — no FORÇADO check applied.
backend.cmd_still_blocked_in_normal: PASS — kind=CMD with estado=true → 400 ('Fancoil em modo AUTOMÁTICO...').

frontend.indicators_panel: PASS — All 8 indicators present (condicao, comando, quadro, status, temperatura, setpoint, pressao, comunicacao). indicator-operacao and indicator-valvula absent as required.
frontend.condicao_buttons: PASS — btn-condicao-normal (disabled when estado=true/active green) and btn-condicao-forcado (enabled, allows switch). AlertDialog opens on click.
frontend.cmd_buttons: PASS — btn-cmd-ligar and btn-cmd-desligar both DISABLED when estado=true (NORMAL), with amber warning message visible: 'Em NORMAL o fancoil segue a programação horária — mude para FORÇADO para comandar manualmente.'
frontend.pressure_control: PASS — pressure-apply initially disabled; after 2x pressure-increment (step 5), apply enabled; clicking Aplicar sent POST kind=PRESSAO and indicator-pressao updated 50.0% → 60.0%. Toast 'Comando PRESSAO enviado' displayed.
frontend.svg_schematic: PASS — data-testid='fancoil-schematic' present; VAG label rendered inside SVG. Fan 'spin' animation style attached but inactive here because status=null (fancoil OFF). Code applies 'animation: spin 0.25s linear infinite' when running=true (status===true).

critical_code_review_comments: mqtt_service.py publish_command uses retain=True for all WRITE_TOPICS including PRESSAO/SET — correct per spec, but keep in mind retained PRESSAO values will persist on broker across reboots.
FancoilDetail.jsx: SVG receives setpoint=serverSp (live). When serverSp is null the badge shows just 'SP --' — minor cosmetic (not an issue in current test).
In NORMAL mode, STATUS and MODO came back as '--' from the real ESP32 (no echo yet). This is expected for the real broker setup and not a bug in iter9.
No regression on CMD validation; PRESSAO path properly bypasses estado check.
seed_data_creation: Created test_iter9_viewer@example.com (viewer) and test_iter9_operator@example.com (operator with empty permissions) for RBAC tests. Pressure restored to 50% at end of suite.
